comment: Recording replaces the buffer rather than overdubbing, and is capped at sixty seconds; it stops of its own accord when the buffer fills. Transients are found by energy onset detection when a sample is loaded, unless the WAV carries cue points, in which case those are used instead. In rotate mode the drift is a small speed offset rather than a gap, which also shifts the pitch a little: ten milliseconds over five seconds is about three and a half cents.
